meta.title: Certified two-sided rational eigenvalue and transition-frequency brackets for the 167Er3+:Y2SiO5 ground-manifold (Z1) effective spin Hamiltonian at the published ZEFOZ field points of arXiv:2412.10126v3
meta.hamiltonian: H = I.A.S + I.Q.I + muB B.g.S - muN gn B.I ; S=1/2, I=7/2; basis |Sz>x|Iz>, Sz in {+1/2,-1/2}, Iz in {7/2..-7/2} descending; units MHz, B in mT; optical frame (D1,D2,b)
meta.inputs: A, Q, g_e exactly as printed in arXiv:2412.10126v3 Appendix B Table 2 (source: S.-J. Wang et al., J. Lumin. 262, 119935 (2023)); muB/h=13.996244936 MHz/mT, muN/h=0.007622593285 MHz/mT (CODATA), gn=-0.1618 (paper)
meta.method: rectangle complex-interval arithmetic over exact rationals (outward rounding); interval LDL^T of H - mu*I; all pivots sign-definite => Sylvester inertia => certified #eigenvalues < mu; eigenvalue brackets from count pairs; sqrt enclosures validated by squaring
meta.scope: CERTIFIED: for each listed exact rational field B, every eigenvalue bracket and transition bracket. NOT CERTIFIED (Phase 1/2 pending): stationarity (ZEFOZ property) of these fields, completeness of any list, gradients/curvatures. Fields for the Table-5 points are float-Newton stationary points polished to |grad| ~ 1e-13 MHz/mT (uncertified) and rounded to exact rationals (2^-20 mT).
